If you do not want to use any of the standard fonts in HTML, you can use Google Fonts. Google Fonts are free to use, and have more than 1000 fonts to choose from. Just add a special style sheet link in the section and then refer to the font in the CSS. For a list of all available Google Fonts, visit ourHow To - Google Fonts Tutorial. To use multiple Google fonts, just separate the font names with a pipe character (|), like this: Of course you can style Google Fonts as you like, with CSS! Google has also enabled different font effects that you can use. First addeffect=effectnameto the Google API, then add a special class name to the element that is going to use the special effect. The class name always starts withfont-effect-and ends with theeffectname.
